contentText: Interim Venezuelan president Delcy Rodriguez is determined to remain head of state after the capture of Nicolas Maduro by US forces. She maintains that no foreign agency rules the country, even as President Donald Trump announces Caracas will be turning over millions of barrels of oil to the United States. Meanwhile, Maduro's supporters demonstrated in the streets of Caracas on behalf of the deposed president.
